name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: To enable Fitness Enthusiasts to meticulously track and analyze advanced performance metrics across various physical activities, ensuring comprehensive data for optimizing their training regimens.

To provide Fitness Enthusiasts with detailed visualizations and reports of their long-term fitness progress, allowing them to identify trends, assess consistency, and make informed adjustments to their goals.

To empower Fitness Enthusiasts to set ambitious and specific fitness goals, and to provide the tools necessary to track their progress towards these goals, fostering continuous improvement and achievement.

To offer Fitness Enthusiasts personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their evolving fitness levels, preferences, and performance data, ensuring optimal training efficiency and effectiveness.
To provide Beginner Users with an intuitive and straightforward way to log their physical activities, making the initial steps of fitness tracking accessible and less daunting.
To help Beginner Users easily understand their fitness progress through clear and encouraging visualizations, fostering motivation and a sense of accomplishment.
To enable Beginner Users to set realistic and flexible fitness goals, providing a clear path for improvement and allowing for adjustments as their fitness journey progresses.
To offer Beginner Users personalized and easy-to-follow workout recommendations that guide them through their fitness journey, building confidence and promoting consistency.
To ensure Wearable Device Users can effortlessly and automatically sync their fitness data from their devices to the application, eliminating manual input and ensuring data accuracy.
To provide Wearable Device Users with immediate access to their real-time fitness metrics from connected devices, enabling them to monitor their performance during activities.
To ensure that all data collected from wearable devices is seamlessly incorporated into the user's overall progress monitoring and goal achievement, providing a holistic view of their fitness.
To enable Social Sharers to easily post details of their completed workouts and activities on various social media platforms, allowing them to share their journey with their network.
To provide Social Sharers with the ability to publicly celebrate their fitness achievements and milestones on social media, fostering a sense of accomplishment and inspiring others.
To facilitate Social Sharers in receiving positive feedback, encouragement, and support from their social network, enhancing their motivation and commitment to fitness.
lowLevelGoals: The Fitness Enthusiast can record their heart rate variability (HRV) data after a workout.
The Fitness Enthusiast can view detailed power output metrics (e.g., average power, normalized power, peak power) for a specific cycling activity.
The Fitness Enthusiast can analyze their running cadence and stride length over a specific period or for individual runs.
The Fitness Enthusiast can compare their current workout performance (e.g., fastest mile, heaviest lift) against their historical personal bests.
The Fitness Enthusiast can generate a report showing their performance trends (e.g., average pace, total distance, calories burned) over the last week.
The Fitness Enthusiast can view a visualization of their total workout volume, broken down by activity type (e.g., running, cycling, strength training), for the current month.
The Fitness Enthusiast can identify periods where their training consistency has increased or decreased based on logged activities.
The Fitness Enthusiast can export their complete historical performance data in a common format (e.g., CSV, GPX) for use with other analysis tools.
The Fitness Enthusiast can create a new goal to run a specific distance (e.g., 10k) within a target time (e.g., 45 minutes).
The Fitness Enthusiast can set a goal to achieve a new personal record (PR) for a specific strength training exercise (e.g., deadlift 200kg).
The Fitness Enthusiast can track their progress towards a body composition goal (e.g., reduce body fat percentage by 5%) by logging relevant measurements.
The Fitness Enthusiast can receive automated notifications when they are approaching a significant milestone for an active goal.
The Fitness Enthusiast can generate a personalized running workout plan that adapts to their recent running performance data and current fitness level.
The Fitness Enthusiast can receive strength training recommendations that consider the recovery status of different muscle groups based on previous workouts.
The Fitness Enthusiast can provide feedback on a workout's perceived exertion, and the system will adjust future workout plan intensity accordingly.
The Fitness Enthusiast can access a library of alternative exercises if a recommended exercise in their workout plan is not suitable or available.
The Beginner User can manually log a walking activity by entering its duration and estimated distance.
The Beginner User can select an activity (e.g., 'running', 'cycling', 'yoga') from a predefined list to quickly log it.
The Beginner User can add a short note or describe their feeling (e.g., 'felt good', 'tired') to a recently logged activity.
The Beginner User can edit the duration, distance, or activity type of an activity they previously logged.
The Beginner User can view a simple bar chart showing their total activity minutes for each day of the current week.
The Beginner User can see a visual badge or award when they complete a predefined number of workouts (e.g., '10 Workouts Completed').
The Beginner User can view a simple summary showing their total distance covered across all activities since they started using the app.
The Beginner User can receive encouraging messages or positive affirmations when they maintain consistent activity levels for a period.
The Beginner User can set a goal to achieve a specific number of activity minutes per week (e.g., '150 minutes of activity').
The Beginner User can adjust the target value of an existing goal (e.g., change '150 minutes' to '180 minutes' for a weekly activity goal).
The Beginner User can receive suggestions for new, achievable goals based on their past activity levels and progress.
The Beginner User can manually mark a goal as completed once they feel they have achieved it.
The Beginner User can access a pre-designed, easy-to-follow 30-minute walking workout plan.
The Beginner User can receive daily workout suggestions (e.g., 'light cardio', 'bodyweight strength') based on their initial preferences.
The Beginner User can view short instructional videos for basic exercises included in their recommended workouts.
The Beginner User can receive push notifications or in-app reminders for their scheduled workout guidance.
The Wearable Device User can connect a new Garmin wearable device to the application for data synchronization.
The Wearable Device User can enable automatic synchronization of their activity data from their Apple Watch to the application.
The Wearable Device User can view the timestamp of the last successful data synchronization from their connected wearable device.
The Wearable Device User can access troubleshooting steps or support resources if they encounter issues with wearable device connection or data sync.
The Wearable Device User can view their real-time heart rate data streamed from a connected chest strap during an active workout.
The Wearable Device User can view their current pace and distance, updated in real-time, from their connected GPS watch during a running activity.
The Wearable Device User can receive audio cues (e.g., 'current pace', 'heart rate zone') from the application based on real-time data from their wearable.
The Wearable Device User can monitor their real-time estimated calorie burn from their connected fitness tracker during an activity.
The Wearable Device User's daily step count is automatically updated in the application from their connected wearable device.
Workouts recorded by a wearable device are automatically added to the user's overall activity history within the application.
The progress towards the Wearable Device User's fitness goals (e.g., weekly distance, calorie burn) is automatically updated using data synced from their wearable.
Sleep data automatically synced from a wearable device is included in the application's calculation and display of the user's recovery metrics.
The Social Sharer can share details of a completed running activity (e.g., distance, time, map) directly to their Instagram Stories.
The Social Sharer can post a summary of their workout (e.g., activity type, duration, calories burned) to their Facebook feed.
The Social Sharer can customize the privacy settings for each shared activity (e.g., 'public', 'friends only', 'private').
The Social Sharer can add a personal caption or message to accompany their shared fitness activity post.
The Social Sharer can share an automatically generated 'New Personal Best' achievement (e.g., fastest 5k) to their Twitter feed.
The Social Sharer can post a 'Workout Streak' milestone (e.g., '30-day workout streak') to their LinkedIn profile.
The Social Sharer can generate a visually appealing, shareable image summarizing their completion of a fitness challenge.
The Social Sharer can tag their friends in a shared fitness achievement post on social media.
The Social Sharer can receive 'likes' and 'comments' from their social network on their shared fitness activity and achievement posts.
The Social Sharer can view a personalized feed displaying the fitness activities and achievements shared by their connected friends.
The Social Sharer can receive notifications (e.g., 'Your friend cheered you on!') when friends interact with their shared content.
The Social Sharer can participate in public fitness challenges alongside their friends, fostering a sense of community and friendly competition.
